propositions: AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, store-surgery, etc.) without [operator-attested] tag are not flagged at plan time, causing acceptance-criteria verification to fail retroactively

The new advisory DET lint must deterministically detect untagged operational-evidence AC items without LLM calls or blocking behavior, using lexicon matching and suppression rules tuned for precision (≥70% over ≥50-item sample, flag rate ≤5%)
The tag-matching regex must be single-sourced between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment path to ensure agreement on what constitutes an [operator-attested] tag
The lint extends p6_ac_quality (advisory, non-blocking) in the packaged floor without adding a new DET check, routing entry, or changing CANONICAL_DET / DET_CHECKS cardinality
Both known-case tickets (115b, 8c4f) must fire on their historical tag-stripped AC text, and already-tagged items must not be flagged
The deterministic eval result (precision, recall, flag-rate, known-case firing) must be committed to frozen corpus files before the lint is activated in p6, verifiable by git-ancestry
